title: Sentinel-2 Land Cover Fractions — Assam Revenue Circles (Annual)
description: Annual land-cover class area fractions (water, trees, flooded vegetation, crops, built area, bare ground, clouds, rangeland) per Revenue Circle in Assam, used as hazard-conditioning covariates in the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk model.
purpose: Land-cover hazard-conditioning covariate for the IDS-DRR Assam flood risk score model.
details: CORRECTION vs the previous draft of this file: the risk model's data dictionary attributes these 8 indicators (water, trees, flooded-vegetation, crops, built-area, bare-ground, clouds, rangeland) to a datasource named 'SENTINEL-2 Land Cover' — a distinct entry from both 'WRIS' (which only covers distance-from-river; see rdls-distance-and-drainage.json) and 'SENTINEL' (which covers mean-ndvi/mean-ndbi; see Sources/SENTINEL/metadata/). This dataset's data physically lives under Sources/WRIS/data/variables/landuse in this repo, which is why the file stays in this folder, but the source attribution below reflects Sentinel-2, not WRIS/India-WRIS. The dictionary also classifies all 8 as 'Hazard' category (not 'Exposure' as an earlier draft of this file assumed), so risk_data_type is 'hazard' here; RDLS's hazard object has no per-metric 'metrics' list the way exposure does, so the 8 land-cover classes are described in the resource rather than as structured hazard sub-objects. License confirmed as 'Creative Commons CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO' per the same dictionary, recorded as 'CC-BY-SA-3.0-IGO' to match RDLS's dash convention. Exact underlying product (e.g. Dynamic World vs ESA WorldCover) is not documented in this repo and should be confirmed with the team.
